features.description: Integration ActionItem catalog: declare the operator-owned integration steps (Firebase functions deploy, Firebase realtime smoke, static-dashboard smoke, Linear credential setup, Discord webhook setup) as ActionItems, each carrying what/why/credentials_required/exact_command/evidence_expected/reversible. Data + projection, not credential handling.
steps: Enumerate the known operator integration steps + their exact commands
Model each as an ActionItem (audience=operator, requires_human where creds needed)
Mark credentials_required + reversible + evidence_expected per item
Fixture tests over the catalog projection
features.acceptance: The catalog emits one ActionItem per integration step with what/why/creds/exact-command/evidence/reversible populated; renders deduped across dashboard + CLI/JSON; leaks no secrets. Verified by fixture tests.

features.description: Static-dashboard smoke action (applies today): a runnable check that `dontpanic state export-dashboard` produces a static dashboard that renders, capturing the run output as evidence. Re-homes the static half of firebase-adapter F005 as an operator action.
steps: Implement a static-smoke runner: export-dashboard → assert artifacts present + parseable
Capture run output as an evidence ref
Wire as the F001 'static-dashboard smoke' ActionItem's exact command
Test: smoke passes on a fixture state; fails loudly on missing/garbled state
features.acceptance: Running the static-dashboard smoke verifies export-dashboard artifacts render and records an evidence ref; it fails clearly on missing/garbled state; no Firebase credentials required.

features.description: Gated realtime/deploy actions: represent Firebase functions deploy + realtime smoke (code already shipped+tested in dashboard/functions/) as ActionItems gated on multi-operator need + credentials. Never auto-executes; surfaces the exact command + evidence the operator must capture. Re-homes firebase-adapter F003/F005 realtime half, parked behind its trigger.
steps: Model deploy + realtime-smoke as gated ActionItems (requires_human=true, credentials_required=true)
Encode the trigger condition (multi-operator dashboard needed) in the item's why/availability
Reference the shipped dashboard/functions/ + firestore.rules as prerequisites met
Test: items render as gated/unavailable until trigger + creds present; never execute in-repo
features.acceptance: Firebase deploy + realtime smoke appear as gated operator ActionItems with exact commands + required evidence, marked credentials_required and reversible-as-applicable; they do not execute in-repo and surface their trigger condition. Verified by tests.

features.description: Integration status surfacing: the dashboard shows each integration as configured / deployed / smoke-passing / pending by consuming the catalog + captured evidence, so the operator sees integration readiness at a glance rather than via command archaeology.
steps: Derive per-integration status from catalog + evidence refs
Pending items link to their F001 ActionItem
Test: status reflects presence/absence of evidence; no secret leak
features.acceptance: The dashboard shows truthful per-integration status driven by catalog + evidence; pending integrations link to their ActionItem; rendering leaks no secrets. Verified by tests.
